reviewScope: All 3,900 photographs fully decoded and visually reviewed in 61 chronological contact sheets. All final selections checked again in 31 larger comparison sheets at up to 492 pixels, with four additional individual checks at up to 790 pixels and the cover opened at 1,000 pixels. Repeated bursts, including different-byte copies, compared visually. The 3,900 hidden AppleDouble sidecars are metadata files, not photographs.
dateSource: Camera-local EXIF DateTimeOriginal and OffsetTimeOriginal (+05:30), 24 August–2 September 2024. No dates inferred from filenames or filesystem timestamps.
locationNotes: Original GPS, visible signs, recognisable architecture and capture order establish the route through Pune, Panchgani, Mahabaleshwar, Lonavala, Mulshi, Tamhini, Matheran and Mumbai.

Kate’s Point, Lodwick Point, Karla, Lohagad, Bhaja, Mapro Garden, Aman Lodge and Matheran are supported by photographed signs and GPS. Temple interiors are grouped under Old Mahabaleshwar where appropriate.
The stone-house stay is labelled Mulshi area, rather than assuming Lavasa from the wider route. Unnamed Tamhini waterfalls and lookouts keep broad labels.
The airport hall on 1 September is before midnight; its murals and aircraft apron follow on 2 September in the original +05:30 local time. Kolkata and return-flight views are omitted.
People and a few personal scenes are included without identifying or matching faces. Their source filenames are listed for later owner review.
criteria: Choose distinct landscapes, architecture, cave interiors, water, forest paths, wildlife, food and street life; omit most repeated posed portraits.
Aim for around ten strong photographs per day/location where possible, with shorter sections for smaller stops and quality ahead of quotas.
Use the Lohagad cover once, outside the gallery, counted on its actual capture date.
Preserve framing, correct orientation and retain source ICC profiles. Export quality-84 WebP at 2,000 pixels long edge; 2,400 for the cover; remove EXIF/XMP.
Keep originals, contact sheets, sidecars and credentials outside Git and R2. Upload only selected WebP derivatives.
